subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` expose existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace root, or should external entries be filtered or neutralized behind the existing workspace boundary?
rationale: The visible UX bug is real, but the PR's chosen fix crosses the existing file metadata boundary, so the permanent product/security contract cannot be inferred from the issue alone.

options.title: Keep Metadata Behind Fs-Safe
options.body: Filter or neutralize external entries and keep all file metadata reads behind `statWorkspacePath` and the existing workspace containment helpers.

options.title: Allow External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: Accept exposing existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned external paths only with explicit security approval, protocol/UI tests, and clear documentation of the contract.

options.title: Split Layout From File Semantics
options.body: Preserve the already-merged layout behavior and handle the external/directory Missing policy in a smaller backend-focused PR.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Behind Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: Filter or neutralize external entries and keep all file metadata reads behind `statWorkspacePath` and the existing workspace containment helpers.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work in the same workspace file browsing surface explicitly preserved the containment and preview safety contract.
